name: EEM Returns by Dollar Regime Quintiles
description: Monthly EEM returns binned by quintiles of U.S. Dollar Index (Broad) monthly changes. Uses expanding percentile rank (period=9999, effectively full-sample) on monthly USD changes to create 5 equal-population bins from weakest (Q1) to strongest (Q5) dollar months. Outputs: scatter of dollar change vs EEM return, quintile return comparison bars, and stats table with N/median/hit rate per quintile.
source:
# EEM Returns Conditional on Dollar Strength/Weakness (Monthly)
# Regime: sign of monthly USD Broad Index change
# Question: Does dollar weakness reliably boost EM returns?

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
ts = index().value

# USD Broad Index (daily, FRED)
usd_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DTWEXBGS')()
usd_daily = ffill(usd_raw.result)

# --- Monthly Aggregation ---
eem_monthly = downsample(target_timeframe=1M)(src.c)
usd_monthly = downsample(target_timeframe=1M)(usd_daily)

# Monthly returns (period=1 on monthly bars = month-over-month)
eem_ret = returns(period=1)(eem_monthly)
usd_ret = returns(period=1)(usd_monthly)

# --- Quintile Classification ---
# Rank USD monthly changes into quintiles using expanding percentile rank
# period=9999 acts as expanding window (uses all available history, no warm-up gap)
usd_pctrank = percentrank(period=9999)(usd_ret)

# Assign quintile bins: Q1 = weakest dollar, Q5 = strongest dollar
usd_quintile = conditional_select(
    is_valid(usd_pctrank) and usd_pctrank <= 20, 1.0,
    is_valid(usd_pctrank) and usd_pctrank <= 40, 2.0,
    is_valid(usd_pctrank) and usd_pctrank <= 60, 3.0,
    is_valid(usd_pctrank) and usd_pctrank <= 80, 4.0,
    is_valid(usd_pctrank) and usd_pctrank <= 100, 5.0
)

# EEM returns split by quintile
eem_q1 = where(usd_quintile == 1.0, eem_ret)
eem_q2 = where(usd_quintile == 2.0, eem_ret)
eem_q3 = where(usd_quintile == 3.0, eem_ret)
eem_q4 = where(usd_quintile == 4.0, eem_ret)
eem_q5 = where(usd_quintile == 5.0, eem_ret)

# --- Output 1: Scatter — Dollar Change vs EEM Return ---
# The raw relationship: is it monotonic or noisy?
xy_scatter(
    title='Stronger Dollar = Weaker EEM?',
    x_axis_label='Monthly USD Index Change (%)',
    y_axis_label='Monthly EEM Return (%)',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    category='Dollar Regime',
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=0
)(x=usd_ret, y_values=eem_ret)

# --- Output 2: Quintile Return Bars (the punchline) ---
# Median EEM return across 5 dollar-change quintiles
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Weaker Dollar = Stronger EEM? Returns by USD Quintile',
    y_axis_label='Median Monthly Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='Dollar Regime',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Weakest $)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3 (Neutral)', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q5 (Strongest $)', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(eem_q1, eem_q2, eem_q3, eem_q4, eem_q5))

# --- Output 3: Stats Table ---
# N, median, hit rate, best, worst per quintile
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EEM Monthly Return Stats by USD Change Quintile',
        row_size=5, col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Months (N)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)', 'Best Month', 'Worst Month'],
        col_headers=['Q1 (Weakest $)', 'Q2', 'Q3 (Neutral)', 'Q4', 'Q5 (Strongest $)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Dollar Regime',
    order=2
)(eem_q1, eem_q2, eem_q3, eem_q4, eem_q5, eem_q1, eem_q2, eem_q3, eem_q4, eem_q5, eem_q1, eem_q2, eem_q3, eem_q4, eem_q5, eem_q1, eem_q2, eem_q3, eem_q4, eem_q5, eem_q1, eem_q2, eem_q3, eem_q4, eem_q5)
